reference_sql:
WITH order_rev AS (
  -- one row per order
  SELECT o.customer_id, o.order_id, o.order_ts, SUM(s.net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur
  FROM orders o
  JOIN sales s ON s.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.customer_id BETWEEN 3001 AND 4000
    AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY o.customer_id, o.order_id, o.order_ts
), windowed AS (
  -- one row per order
  SELECT customer_id, order_id, order_ts, revenue_eur,
    AVG(revenue_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_ts, order_id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_3,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_ts, order_id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS orders_in_window
  FROM order_rev
)
SELECT customer_id, order_id, order_ts, revenue_eur, ROUND(avg_3, 2) AS avg_order_value_3
FROM windowed
WHERE orders_in_window = 3

WITH order_rev AS (
  -- one row per order
  SELECT o.customer_id, o.order_id, o.order_ts, SUM(s.net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur
  FROM orders o
  JOIN sales s ON s.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.customer_id BETWEEN 3001 AND 4000
    AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY o.customer_id, o.order_id, o.order_ts
), paired AS (
  -- one row per order
  SELECT customer_id, order_id, order_ts, revenue_eur,
    LAG(revenue_eur, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_ts, order_id) AS prev_1,
    LAG(revenue_eur, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_ts, order_id) AS prev_2
  FROM order_rev
)
SELECT customer_id, order_id, order_ts, revenue_eur, ROUND((revenue_eur + prev_1 + prev_2) / 3, 2) AS avg_order_value_3
FROM paired
WHERE prev_2 IS NOT NULL

WITH o AS (
  SELECT od.customer_id, od.order_id, od.order_ts, SUM(s.net_revenue_eur) AS revenue_eur
  FROM orders od JOIN sales s ON s.order_id = od.order_id
  WHERE od.customer_id BETWEEN 3001 AND 4000
    AND CAST(od.order_ts AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
  GROUP BY od.customer_id, od.order_id, od.order_ts
), w AS (
  SELECT customer_id, order_id, order_ts, revenue_eur,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_ts, order_id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS n,
    AVG(revenue_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_ts, order_id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg3
  FROM o
)
SELECT customer_id, order_id, order_ts, revenue_eur, ROUND(avg3, 2) AS avg_order_value_3
FROM w
WHERE n = 3
